questions.prompt: Which change is correct when the game gets deeper?

choices.text: Stack off more dominated offsuit hands preflop
Value suited connectors more and offsuit one-pair hands less

questions.explanation: Depth rewards hands that can make the nuts and punishes big dominated pairs.

questions.prompt: A nit 3-bets your button open. The exploit is…

choices.text: Fold the bottom of your continue range. Their 3-bet is strong.

questions.explanation: Tight 3-bets are value. Do not pay them off with the hands you opened as steals.

questions.prompt: Effective stacks are 15bb, folded to the button, you have AJo. The fitting plan is…

choices.text: Limp and fold to a jam
Raise all-in or raise an amount you are willing to call off
Fold. AJo is an under-the-gun hand only.

questions.explanation: At 15bb the button does not have a deep postflop tree. Decide for the stack now.

questions.prompt: Which fact about a straddle should you remember in this app?

choices.text: The trainer deals straddles, bomb pots, and rake in every hand
Straddles are conceptual here: the straddle acts like a larger big blind until the engine deals them

questions.explanation: Do not expect a dealt straddle in the current hand engine. Learn the position shift now and apply it live.
